corpus_rules.name: draw_from_papers
corpus_rules.statement: DA may draw from published work, including people who are gone
corpus_rules.why: The unit is the paper trail. Alive or not does not matter.

corpus_rules.name: pair_two_or_three
corpus_rules.statement: Sit one corpus next to two or three others and emit one sentence
corpus_rules.why: That is the lead. The sentence still has to be scored.

corpus_rules.name: slot_and_killer
corpus_rules.statement: The sentence names one slot and a check that could kill it
corpus_rules.why: Otherwise it is not a proposal.

corpus_rules.name: pairing_writes_F
corpus_rules.statement: The pairing writes a theory of everything / F
corpus_rules.why: A corpus method is not a producing-map.

corpus_rules.name: pairing_closes_B
corpus_rules.why: Leray + BKM + CKN are constraints. Domain B stays open.

corpus_rules.name: pairing_unshelves
corpus_rules.statement: The pairing unshelves SFE or retunes nodes.json
corpus_rules.why: Motive may come back. The close may not.

corpus_rules.name: vote_replaces_check
corpus_rules.statement: A vote of names replaces a check
corpus_rules.why: A program review types demands. It does not collapse the wave.

program_review.name: Einstein
program_review.looks_at_da: DA already keeps G_μν+Λg = 8πG T_SM. Good. Catalogs without a principle are not a theory.
program_review.improve_program: Every slot states the principle before the list. Covariance, an action, what is forbidden.
program_review.how_to_derive: Write the principle, then the operator, then compute the spectrum as a consequence. Do not start from eigenvalues and hope they remember the metric.
program_review.cannot: cannot output G or Λ; cannot close a theorem by sitting here

program_review.name: Tesla
program_review.owns: a resonator you can tune and detune
program_review.looks_at_da: A program that cannot be detuned is a slogan. DA's checkers are the closest thing to an apparatus on this desk.
program_review.improve_program: Every claim names the knob you turn and the script that must move. If nothing is detunable, it does not sit.
program_review.how_to_derive: Build the resonator first (name D). Listen second (compute σ(D)). Standing waves are what a built operator does, not a universe brand.
program_review.cannot: cannot derive SU(3) or Einstein's equation; not a ToE chair

program_review.name: Feynman
program_review.owns: a kernel you can compute with
program_review.looks_at_da: If the vocabulary does not produce a number you can get wrong, it is a stamp collection.
program_review.improve_program: No new name sits until it has a fail-able computation. Refuse councils. Refuse vibes.
program_review.how_to_derive: Pick (X, D). Compute one λ, one matrix element, or one χ² you can miss. That is how you derive a DA-like program: the check is the program.
program_review.cannot: cannot vote the destination into a pass; cannot unshelve SFE

program_review.name: Weyl
program_review.looks_at_da: DA says 'harmonic math' and 'gauge' in the same breath too often. Those are different additions.
program_review.improve_program: Do not utter gauge until G and the reps are named. Peter–Weyl is not SU(3)×SU(2)×U(1).
program_review.how_to_derive: Climb G3 only after G0–G2. The group is an input. The harmonics of that group are the output.
program_review.cannot: cannot choose nature's G from a Laplacian on S^2

program_review.name: Wigner
program_review.owns: particles as representations; spectrum with a group
program_review.looks_at_da: A spectrum with no group is a hydrogen textbook, not a particle table.
program_review.improve_program: Type every mode by the representation it sits in. If you cannot, you are not at the ground of matter.
program_review.how_to_derive: The program asks: which group, which rep, which operator that commutes with the group. Then the spectrum is classified, not wished.
program_review.cannot: cannot turn a classification into the numerical couplings

program_review.name: von Neumann
program_review.owns: spectral theorem: operator on a Hilbert space
program_review.looks_at_da: Talk of a harmonic universe that never names the Hilbert space and the operator is not mathematics.
program_review.improve_program: G0 and G1 are mandatory. No slot opens with 'modes' alone.
program_review.how_to_derive: A DA-like program is: specify H, specify a self-adjoint D, diagonalize, store the residual. That is the whole machine at ground level.
program_review.cannot: cannot pick D from poetry; cannot make {λ_n} write F
